article_body_content:
You can create an AI-generated video in under 5 minutes using free tools like Kling AI or Pika. The process is simple: write a text prompt describing what you want, click generate, and wait 30-90 seconds. No video editing skills, expensive software, or technical knowledge required.

This guide walks you through the entire process step-by-step. By the end, you'll have created your first AI video and understand how to improve your results with better prompts.

Quick Start: alici.ai Video Studio lets you access multiple AI video models (Kling, Runway, Veo, Pika) in one place. Try free →

What You'll Need

Before starting, make sure you have:

  • An internet connection - AI video generation happens in the cloud

  • A free account on an AI video platform (we'll set this up in Step 1)

  • 5 minutes of your time

  • A simple idea for your first video (we'll provide examples)

That's it. No downloads, no installations, no credit card required for your first videos.

The 3-Step Process

Creating an AI video is surprisingly simple:

Let's walk through each step in detail.

Step 2: Write Your Prompt (2 minutes)

The prompt is the most important part. It tells the AI exactly what video to create.

Basic Prompt Structure

[Subject] + [Action] + [Setting] + [Style]

Example Prompts for Beginners

Simple (Good for first attempt):

A golden retriever running through a sunny meadow

Medium (More specific):

A golden retriever puppy running through a sunny meadow with wildflowers, slow motion, cinematic lighting

Advanced (Professional results):

A golden retriever puppy running joyfully through a sunlit meadow filled with purple wildflowers, slow motion footage, golden hour lighting, shallow depth of field, 4K quality

What Makes a Good Prompt

Prompts to Avoid

  • ❌ Too vague: "a cool video"

  • ❌ Too complex: "a man walks into a bar, orders a drink, talks to three different people, then leaves and drives home"

  • ❌ Copyrighted content: "Spider-Man fighting Darth Vader"

Pro Tip: Start simple. Your first prompt should be one sentence with a clear subject and action.

Step 3: Generate Your Video (2 minutes)

Now the fun part—watching AI create your video.

Generation Process

  1. Paste your prompt into the text box

  2. Select settings (if available): Duration: Start with 5 seconds, Aspect ratio: 16:9 for landscape, 9:16 for vertical, Quality: Standard is fine for testing

  3. Click Generate

  4. Wait 30-90 seconds (generation time varies by platform and model)

  5. Preview your video

  6. Download if you're happy, or regenerate with a modified prompt

What to Expect

Your first video might not be perfect. That's normal. AI video generation is iterative—you'll improve your results by:

  • Adjusting your prompt based on the output

  • Trying different style keywords

  • Experimenting with different AI models

Improving Your Results

Once you've created your first video, here's how to get better:

1. Use the Right Model for Your Content

2. Master Prompt Keywords

For cinematic quality:

  • "cinematic lighting"

  • "shallow depth of field"

  • "4K quality"

  • "professional footage"

For specific styles:

  • "anime style"

  • "vintage film"

  • "neon cyberpunk"

  • "watercolor painting"

For better motion:

  • "slow motion"

  • "smooth camera pan"

  • "tracking shot"

  • "timelapse"

3. Use Negative Prompts

Some platforms let you specify what to avoid:

Negative: blurry, distorted faces, low quality, watermark
Common Questions from Beginners

How long can AI videos be?

Most free tiers generate 5-10 second clips. Paid plans offer 10-30 seconds. For longer videos, you can stitch clips together in any video editor.

Are AI videos free to use commercially?

It depends on the platform. Most paid plans include commercial usage rights. Always check the specific platform's terms. alici.ai, Runway, and Kling all permit commercial use on paid subscriptions.

Do I need a powerful computer?

No. All processing happens in the cloud. You just need a device with a web browser.

How do I make AI videos of people?

AI can generate realistic human motion, but results vary. For best results:

  • Use Kling 2.0 (best for human subjects)

  • Keep movements simple

  • Avoid complex facial expressions

  • Consider using AI avatar tools like Synthesia for talking-head videos

Can I upload my own images?

Yes! Most platforms support image-to-video generation. Upload a photo and the AI will animate it. This is great for:

  • Product photos

  • Artwork

  • Portraits

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the easiest AI video generator for beginners?

alici.ai Video Studio is the easiest option because it provides access to multiple AI models (Kling, Runway, Veo, Pika) through a single interface. You don't need to create separate accounts or learn different platforms. The built-in prompt assistant also helps beginners write effective prompts.

How much does it cost to make AI videos?

You can make AI videos for free using the free tiers of most platforms. Pika offers 150 free credits monthly, Kling offers 66 credits, and alici.ai has a free tier. Paid plans range from $5-30/month depending on your needs, with most creators finding $10-15/month sufficient for regular use.

What's the best prompt for AI video generation?

The best prompts follow a simple structure: Subject + Action + Setting + Style + Quality. For example: "A butterfly landing on a purple flower, macro photography, natural sunlight, slow motion, 4K quality." Start simple and add detail based on results.

Can AI-generated videos be used on YouTube and social media?

Yes, AI-generated videos can be used on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and other social platforms. Most AI video tools grant commercial usage rights on paid plans. Always check the specific platform's terms of service. Content should be original and not infringe on copyrights.

How long does it take to generate an AI video?

Most AI video generators produce 5-10 second clips in 30-90 seconds. Faster models like Pika can generate in 15-30 seconds, while higher-quality models like Kling may take 2-5 minutes. Generation time depends on the model, video length, and server load.
